_comment: AGENT: always read this file via the task-index-manager skill before reading or writing any task state.

tasks.title: Azure Planner Path Baseline Validation
tasks.notes: Run real Azure path with representative prompts; collect and replay provider traces; record fixtures for regression.

tasks.title: World Scan — prismarine-chunk 1.21.x Compatibility
tasks.notes: Test readRegionBlocks against local spigot-1.21.1.jar world files. If incompatible evaluate direct NBT parsing or plugin-side scan endpoint. Until verified, view requests outside initial payload return graceful scan-unavailable.

tasks.title: Execution UX and Job Control
tasks.notes: Progress/status messaging, per-step failure surfacing, cancellation semantics. Coordinate with refinement-loop and undo design.

tasks.title: Benchmark and Evaluation Harness
tasks.notes: Repeatable scenario fixtures, automatic scoring for structural validity / terrain intrusion / palette diversity / budget. Baseline-vs-new comparisons before enabling each major phase.

tasks.title: Bug: parseRequestedBlock silently ignores ids after the first
tasks.notes: Fix when touched. Returns only first matched minecraft: id; multi-block messages lose later ids. Document before expanding material resolution.

tasks.title: Bug: managedBlocks unbounded cache in BridgeServer
tasks.notes: Fix when touched. Never evicts. Fine for dev session; add max-size cap or session-scoped reset for long-running server.

tasks.title: Bug: serverContextJson dimension format mismatch
tasks.notes: Fix when touched. Plugin sends NORMAL/NETHER/THE_END; TS fixtures use minecraft:overworld. Align if dimension becomes meaningful.

tasks.title: Phase 2 — Terrain Context and Blending
tasks.notes: TerrainContextCard generator, terrain-adaptive compile transforms, placement mode expansion, primitive hardening. Terrain context now feeds into initial world scan for AI loop.

tasks.title: Phase 3 — Retrieval, Refinement, and Undo
tasks.notes: Retrieval library, bounded refinement loop with DIG patches, transaction log, undo buffer, material variety quality gates. Gate behind benchmark outcomes.

tasks.title: Decorative and Biome Style Expansion
tasks.notes: Richer detail passes, style presets, biome-aware material preferences, repair mode. Keep separate from correctness milestones.

tasks.title: Nearby Build Preservation
tasks.notes: Detect likely player-made nearby structures. Add avoidance/protection policies during planning and execution. Requires stable terrain/context.
